note: The tree the application-level reference qualification measures: the v28 destination's final loop commit plus ONLY the recipe applications listed here. It is a qualification candidate, not a migration outcome and not an accepted tree. The v28 bundle is local ignored evidence (tmp/loop-qualification-20260929/v28-dest.bundle in the operator checkout); it is not committed. Pass it with REFQUAL_V28_BUNDLE or --bundle.

baseline.first_package_failure: ArcProcessor#registerBeans: SpEL expressions are not supported when using org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value. Offending value is '@Value("#{servletContext.contextPath}")' (RootRestController)

recipe_applications.why: the recipe's acceptance refuses 'a field that read the Servlet context through SpEL left on the handler's type' (unit:handler-parameter-sites) and gate:augmentation refuses the package; the v28 handler already had the recipe's @Context UriInfo form and kept the field. The patch removes the field and its import; nothing else.
recipe_applications.honesty: a recipe-stated edit applied by the qualification, not by the loop; the measured tree is reported as baseline + this patch, never as v28's output

database.why: the destination's own decided datasource (quarkus.datasource.db-kind=postgresql, ADR-009) and its generated baseline data; credentials are the environment references the tree declares (PETCLINIC_DB_URL/USER/PASSWORD), filled from the disposable container
